posts.author: Falc0n
posts.body:
Hello to you all!
After a long break from RPG Making (very long in fact), I decided to do RPG Making again this year and hope I will finish my project this time also. I will use RPG Maker MZ this time since I have to start my old project all over again because it will be the same if I continue on VX (gotta redo 85% of the maps since I used Hanzo Kimura tilesets) and I try to do it properly this time.
Even though I joined at 2014, this is my first post here. So, nice to meet you all.
Note : Kinda sad that rpgmakervx.net forum is dead.
